content: Expo docs SDK 57 (fetched 2026-08-06): expo-print printToFileAsync renders HTML to PDF and saves to the app CACHE directory (verified: 'saves it to app's cache directory'); included in Expo Go; iOS local asset URLs unsupported in HTML (must inline base64); Android margins controlled via @page CSS; base64:true option available. CRITICAL: expo-file-system has a new class-based API (File/Directory/Paths, SDK 54+) and the legacy API (writeAsStringAsync, readAsStringAsync, StorageAccessFramework, documentDirectory) is DEPRECATED — the docs state legacy methods 'will throw in runtime' unless imported from 'expo-file-system/legacy'. StorageAccessFramework (requestDirectoryPermissionsAsync + createFileAsync + writeAsStringAsync base64) remains the Android path to write into user-selected folders like Downloads (per SheetJS official RN demo, tested on devices). iOS path: documentDirectory + sharing (UIFileSharingEnabled/LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace via config plugin; note: Expo Go cannot change Info.plist — share sheet is the Expo Go-compatible approach).
